# 音频版组件许可来源

此目录保留 Android 音频组件及其运行库的许可原文，不修改许可条款。FFmpegKit 的总许可、上游声明和固定构建源码链接见上一层目录。组件源码下载位置可在固定版本的 [构建脚本](https://github.com/ffmpegkit-maintained/ffmpeg/blob/v6.0.4-lts-android/android-6.0-lts/scripts/function.sh) 中查阅；以下为本目录许可文件的来源。

| 文件 | 许可原文来源 |
| --- | --- |
| libvorbis.txt | [Xiph Vorbis v1.3.7 COPYING](https://github.com/xiph/vorbis/blob/v1.3.7/COPYING) |
| libogg.txt | [Xiph Ogg v1.3.5 COPYING](https://github.com/xiph/ogg/blob/v1.3.5/COPYING) |
| opus.txt | [Xiph Opus v1.4 COPYING](https://github.com/xiph/opus/blob/v1.4/COPYING) |
| speex.txt | [Xiph Speex 1.2.1 COPYING](https://github.com/xiph/speex/blob/Speex-1.2.1/COPYING) |
| libilbc.txt | [libilbc v3.0.4 COPYING](https://github.com/TimothyGu/libilbc/blob/v3.0.4/COPYING) |
| cpu-features.txt | [Google cpu_features v0.8.0 LICENSE](https://github.com/google/cpu_features/blob/v0.8.0/LICENSE) |
| libcxx.txt | [LLVM libc++ LICENSE.TXT](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/llvmorg-18.1.8/libcxx/LICENSE.TXT)，与固定 NDK r21d 的 `sources/cxx-stl/llvm-libc++/NOTICE` 字节相同 |
| libcxxabi-NOTICE.txt / libcxxabi-LICENSE.txt | 固定 [NDK r21d 官方归档](https://dl.google.com/android/repository/android-ndk-r21d-windows-x86_64.zip) 中 `sources/cxx-stl/llvm-libc++abi/` 的原始文件 |
| shine.txt | [Shine 3.1.1 COPYING](https://github.com/toots/shine/blob/3.1.1/COPYING) |
| soxr.txt | [SoXR 0.1.3 COPYING.LGPL](https://github.com/chirlu/soxr/blob/0.1.3/COPYING.LGPL) |
| twolame.txt | [TwoLAME 0.4.0 COPYING](https://github.com/njh/twolame/blob/0.4.0/COPYING) |
| lame-COPYING.txt / lame-LICENSE.txt | [LAME 3.100 源码镜像许可](https://github.com/arthenica/lame/tree/RELEASE__3_100/lame) |
| libiconv.txt | [libiconv v1.17 COPYING.LIB](https://github.com/arthenica/libiconv/blob/v1.17/COPYING.LIB) |
| opencore-amr.txt | [opencore-amr v0.1.6 LICENSE](https://github.com/arthenica/opencore-amr/blob/v0.1.6/LICENSE) |
| vo-amrwbenc.txt | [vo-amrwbenc v0.1.3 COPYING](https://github.com/arthenica/vo-amrwbenc/blob/v0.1.3/COPYING) |
| smart-exception.txt | [Smart Exception v0.2.1 LICENSE](https://github.com/tanersener/smart-exception/blob/v0.2.1/LICENSE) |

上游 `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` 是通用声明，此目录补充音频版启用的外部库许可。发行时将整个目录与父目录的许可、声明和源码链接一起提供。
